text:
deploy-bot: Post-deploy: rollout v2.3.5 -> us-west canary (30%). Starting synthetic probes for text-gen and embeddings. Link: https://deploys.redwood/release/696f
ana: Noticed embedding synth p95 jumped from ~1.2s to 3.8s and a small # of 500s showing up within last 2 mins.
mike: grabbing logs and traces now, can reproduce a single 500 locally.
eva: logs show kv-cache miss on gpukv-12 and subsequent timeout to kv-service: "GET /kv/prefix(...) 504". Only affects embed path.
mike: quick reproduce curl:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-1","input":"test"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```
jordan: text-gen synths all green, p50/p95 stable. Embed route is the only failing probe.
ana: proposal: PAUSE rollout, pin traffic to previous stable v2.3.4 for new sessions, and run targeted kv prefill (warmup) to avoid cache misses. Hotfix PR to add a kvcache-miss fallback could follow.
sre-oncall: agree. I'll raise a temporary alert rule: embed_5xx_rate > 0.5% for 10m. Also notify infra to check gpukv pool health.
deploy-bot: Rollout paused (ack). Canary instances left at 30%. Pin request sent to routing team to prefer v2.3.4 for new clients.
eva: started prefill job: `/ops/warmup --service=embeddings --prefix="user:" --parallel=10` — ETA ~12m. Posting progress updates.
mike: I'll open a tiny runtime guard PR to fallback to non-quantized embedding variant on kvcache timeout.
jordan: runbook note: add step to prefill kv on canary that touches embeddings routes. I'll update /runbooks/postdeploy-smoke.md :thumbsup:
sre-oncall: monitoring set, infra alerted. If embed 5xx persists after warmup we'll roll back to v2.3.4 cluster-wide.
deploy-bot: Thread updated at 1748501290 — paused + prefill started. Please react with :eyes: when you want to unpause.
